messages:
Incident Bot: ALERT: embedding-service tail_latency_p95 > 1500ms for 3m — paging @SRE Oncall
SRE Oncall: ack. jumping in. please hold non-essential pages. I'll triage and coordinate mitigations.
Maria G: seeing increased queue depth in gpu-pool-2, backpressure spikes in router logs. snippet: ```ERR backlog=126 node=gpu-2 processing=24```
AJ: any customer-facing 5xx spikes or only client-side timeouts?
SRE Oncall: 5xx steady, but client-side timeouts and p99 end-to-end latency up. likely slow token generation, KV-cache misses look high. fallback routing to smaller model triggered for some traffic.
Jun Park: pushed a temporary rate-shed rule at the edge for non-critical flows to protect core traffic (will revert after warm-up).
Olivia T: tagging incident as alert-noise candidate — per previous discussions we should gate the alert with queue depth. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/embeddings-latency?panel=2
Samir K: support reported 2 customers with retries visible; CS looped in and drafting a message.
SRE Oncall: mitigation checklist: 1) prewarm KV cache for top prefixes 2) enforce smaller-model routing for large requests 3) silence noisy pager while we instrument for root cause.
Maria G: kicked off a quick prewarm job: ```curl -X POST https://internal-cache/prewarm -d '{\'prefix\':\'user:top-1000\'}'``` hit rate improved from ~5% -> ~60% after warm.
AJ: i'll apply a temporary pager silence. propose we change alert to fire only when p95 > 1500ms AND queue_depth > 80 to reduce noise.
SRE Oncall: agree. AJ update the rule and add a playbook annotation. keep old rule as archived version.
AJ: updated alert rule in monitoring repo at https://git.redwood/monitors/alerts/embedding-service.yaml@rev-485. Diff snippet: ```- expr: embedding_tail_p95 > 1500
+ expr: embedding_tail_p95 > 1500 and embedding_queue_depth > 80
  annotations: |
    summary: Tail latency spike with queue buildup```
Jun Park: added playbook note in the embeddings playbook: https://docs.internal.redwood/playbooks/embeddings#tail-latency with steps for cache prewarm and model-fallback triggers.
SRE Oncall: assign post-incident owners: Maria -> KV cache tuning, Jun -> rate-shed rules and revert plan, AJ -> alert rule PR and monitoring tests, Olivia -> dashboard panels, Samir -> customer follow-ups.
Maria G: taking KV cache tuning. I'll add recommended TTLs and a small prewarm helper that runs on deploy.
Olivia T: adding a new Grafana panel showing queue_depth vs tail_latency and annotate incident timeframe. PR: https://git.redwood/grafana/panels/323
Samir K: collecting CS notes and will notify affected customers with an ETA and mitigation summary.
SRE Oncall: i'm handing off in 30m. maintenance window: silence applied for 45m; resume alerts after. leave detailed action items in the playbook and this thread.
Incident Bot: NOTE: Pager silence applied by AJ for 45m. Incident tags: alert-tuning, cache-prewarm
AJ: quick internal note: we reduced noisy pages by gating with queue depth; we'll evaluate adding a long-term synthetic to catch cache-warm issues.
Maria G: short-term metrics after mitigations: p95 dropped from 1700ms -> 520ms, queue_depth from 120 -> 30. monitoring will watch for 2 hours.
SRE Oncall: thanks all. next steps: draft postmortem, link PRs, update playbook ownership page, and add runbook annotations where needed.
Olivia T: added playbook annotation: when prewarm hit rate < 20% trigger prewarm job and consider increasing cache allocation. link: https://docs.internal.redwood/playbooks/embeddings#annotations
SRE Oncall: final: if recurrence occurs, escalate to infra-runtime for kernel-level profiling. closing handoff at 2008123678.
